title: Error in describing degree no ground to unseat MLA: Manipur High Court upholds election of BJP's Karam Shyam
description: The Manipur High Court has upheld the election of Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) candidate Karam Shyam from the Langthabal Assembly constituency in the 2022 assembly elections [Okram Joy Singh Vs Karam Shyam].In a judgment delivered on July 14, Chief Justice M Sundar rejected the claim by Congress candidate Okram Joy Singh that Shyam made false disclosures about his landholdings and educational qualification in his election affidavitThe Court held that Shyam’s description of his bachelor’s degree
